name: WNYMesh
tagline: A Western New York community emergency network.
description: WNYMesh helps Western New York neighbors stay connected when the power and cell service go out, through a volunteer-built community radio network, preparedness education, and events that bring people together.
taxStatus: WNYMesh Inc. is a New York not-for-profit corporation recognized by the IRS as tax-exempt under section 501(c)(3). Donations are tax-deductible to the extent allowed by law.
boardNote: WNYMesh is led by a five-member volunteer Board of Directors. We'll introduce the rest of the board here soon.
